patch.value: GH-862: pm-beads must map Beads close reasons into native resolution metadata

Closed Beads records can carry close rationale that is not mapped into pm resolution, expected_result, actual_result, and close_reason metadata. Import must preserve source meaning in native terminal fields without inventing evidence.

Known Beads close-reason variants map deterministically into native PM terminal metadata; absent source fields remain explicitly unavailable rather than fabricated; comments/events remain lossless; imported closed records satisfy resolution validation where the source provides sufficient evidence; package and installed-consumer acceptance pass
Retain terminal decision context across Beads migrations
Makes imported closed work reconstructable and compatible with strict PM validation
GitHub issue #862 identifies a live terminal-metadata parity gap
